name: CSO_CONTENT_TEXT_PUB
description: This table contains the published versions of the CONTENTTEXT records. Records in this table are returned by the JSP tag library.

columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to content table record.

columns.name: CONTENT_TEXT_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to content text table record.

columns.name: INDEX_MASTER_IDENTIFIERS
columns.description: The concatenated list of channel attributes marked as master identifiers. This value may be truncated if the total length is greater than the column size.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: The locale associated with the current record.

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.description: The obsolete GUID of the current owner of the document, this is not necessarily the same as the creator of the document.

columns.name: OWNER_NAME
columns.description: de-normalized name of the document owner.

columns.name: PRIORITY_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to LOOKUP_CODE that indicates the priority of the content record for sorting purposes.

columns.name: PUBLISHED_DATE
columns.description: This is the datetime when the record was published.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: REQUIRES_TRANSLATION
columns.description: Flag indicating if the master content record needs to be translated to other supported locales, it is better to rely on the task functionlaity to determine all translation needs.

columns.name: ANSWERED
columns.description: Deprecated. Flag indicating if the record was moderated. Only applies if this record is a threaded discussion record and the channel has been marked as “requires moderation‿

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: Datetime record was added to repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: Datetime record was last modified in repository.

columns.name: CREATE_DATE
columns.description: Datetime the original record was created. In the case of imported records this data may not be equal to the DATEADDED or PUBLISHED_DATE.

columns.name: DISPLAY_END_DATE
columns.description: This is the datetime when the record is no longer valid to be viewed. The record may still be published but it will not be returned to the JSP tag library.

columns.name: DISPLAY_START_DATE
columns.description: This is the datetime when the record is available to be viewed. The record can be published but if the start date is after the current date it will not be returned by the JSP tag library.

columns.name: EVENT_END_DATE
columns.description: If the channel supports event calendars, then this column specifies the datetime the event is scheduled to end.

columns.name: EVENT_START_DATE
columns.description: If the channel supports event calendars, then this column specifies the datetime the event is scheduled to start.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to content record's document id.

columns.name: OWNER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: The ID of the current owner of the document, this is not necessarily the same as the creator of the document.
